# iCouldPlay Tutorials: Video, NAS and Subtitles

> Start with a local video, connect NAS folders and media servers, organise films and series, then check subtitles, audio tracks and playback compatibility.

## App and version

- [iCouldPlay: Video Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/icouldplay/index.md): Learn about iCouldPlay local videos, SMB, WebDAV, FTP, media servers, subtitles and playback engines through 100 practical tutorials.
Version listed: 1.1.1; checked 2026-11-08; iOS 15.0+ / iPadOS 15.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. iCouldPlay getting started: add a local video to your media library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-getting-started/index.md): Import your own video from Files, check the local source, picture, sound and viewing progress, and understand the relationship between the library and original file. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [2. Import Photos videos into iCouldPlay: organise travel clips and check orientation](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-photo-import/index.md): Import a few travel videos through Photos, checking complete downloads, orientation, duration and duplicates to build a repeatable personal-video workflow. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [3. Connect iCouldPlay to SMB: play home videos from a NAS share](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-smb-nas/index.md): Distinguish the SMB host, share name and base path, connect a home NAS and use a small folder to check permissions, scanning and actual playback. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [4. Connect iCouldPlay to WebDAV: enter the address, folder and account correctly](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-webdav-cloud/index.md): Distinguish a WebDAV service address, webpage sharing link and base path, then verify login, directory access and playback of the same file. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [5. iCouldPlay FTP sources: test connections and playback with a small folder](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-ftp-source/index.md): Add an FTP source and check login, base directory, subfolders and actual video access separately, understanding the differences and limits of FTP, FTPS and SFTP. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [6. Connect iCouldPlay to Emby: sign in and choose your media library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-emby-library/index.md): Use the Emby server address and account permissions to sign in, browse libraries and check movie details and playback, distinguishing server accounts from file-share accounts. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [7. Connect iCouldPlay to Jellyfin: find films and series from your server](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-jellyfin-library/index.md): Connect an existing Jellyfin service, check the actual port, user-library scope, seasons and episodes, and distinguish empty lists, missing metadata and playback failures. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [8. Connect iCouldPlay to Plex: authorise, select a server and check empty libraries](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-plex-library/index.md): Authorise the Plex account, enter the real server address and separately check the account, server reachability, library permissions and video playback. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [9. Connect iCouldPlay to UGREEN video: check service addresses and media access](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-ugreen-library/index.md): Follow UGREEN video support in iCouldPlay 1.1.0, distinguish NAS administration and video-service addresses, then verify login, libraries and playback in order. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [10. iCouldPlay folder scans: turn a file source into a browsable library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-folder-scan/index.md): Begin with one clear source folder, choose the scan scope and verify items and categories, then handle missed files, matching names and rescan limits. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [11. iCouldPlay movie matching: use titles and years to reduce poster mistakes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-movie-naming/index.md): Organise film titles, years and edition details before scanning, check posters and descriptions with a small sample, and retain original files and viewing records. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [12. Correct iCouldPlay metadata: distinguish same-title films and editions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-metadata-correction/index.md): Before changing a wrong poster or description, identify its file and metadata source, then check title, year, film-versus-series type and server metadata without deleting the video by mistake. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [13. Organise series in iCouldPlay: check seasons, episodes and filenames](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-episode-naming/index.md): Use a consistent series name and S01E01 numbering, then verify seasons, episode numbers and playback order, including the limits of specials, compilations and multiple editions. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [14. iCouldPlay search and resume: return to your last viewing position](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-search-resume/index.md): Confirm the media source and search scope, find your videos with short keywords, then verify how progress, Continue Watching and Play From Beginning relate. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [15. Browse iCouldPlay libraries: categories and card density for a viewing list](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-library-categories/index.md): Organise browsing by source, film-or-series category and library column count, checking empty filters, duplicate cards and readable titles across devices. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [16. iCouldPlay external subtitles: import SRT and check the video edition](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-external-subtitles/index.md): Load an SRT for your video and check language, timing and edition, distinguishing a fixed offset, gradual drift and subtitles already burned into the picture. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [17. iCouldPlay subtitle layout: adjust size, outline and position](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-subtitle-style/index.md): Start with matching ordinary subtitles and compare type size, contrast, outline and placement, checking portrait, landscape, long lines and light scenes. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [18. iCouldPlay audio tracks: select a language and troubleshoot silent video](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-audio-tracks/index.md): Distinguish audio tracks from subtitle languages, check available sound, system output and file details, and locate issues affecting only some videos. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [19. Troubleshoot iCouldPlay compatibility: playback engines and video formats](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-player-engine/index.md): Distinguish containers, video codecs, audio tracks and subtitles, understand automatic selection between the two engines, and compare the same file locally and remotely to locate failures. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [20. Troubleshoot iCouldPlay streaming stalls: files, networks and servers](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-network-buffering/index.md): Compare local and remote playback of one video to locate buffering, failed seeking and disconnections, checking local and remote networks, server transcoding and file bitrate. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [21. iCouldPlay reference clip: build a one-minute playback baseline](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-playback-reference-clip/index.md): Use your own short clip to establish known pictures, sound and timestamps for local and remote comparisons. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [22. iCouldPlay same-name imports: distinguish skipped files and separate versions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-same-name-import-copies/index.md): Test distinguishable videos with matching filenames and preserve originals before naming separate copies. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [23. Watch portrait video in iCouldPlay: distinguish rotation, fitting and cropping](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-portrait-video-framing/index.md): Compare portrait playback across orientation and framing choices with visible edge markers. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [24. Before importing cloud files into iCouldPlay: verify actual local data](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-cloud-file-provider-preflight/index.md): Separate file-provider downloads, app import and offline playback using one known short clip. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [25. Identify film cuts in iCouldPlay: map duration, scenes and subtitles](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-film-edition-duration-map/index.md): Map original, short and revised edits using duration and scene anchors, then verify progress and subtitle counterparts. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [26. iCouldPlay WebVTT practice: create three cues for your own clip](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-make-webvtt-practice/index.md): Create a minimal WebVTT file for a personal clip and verify format, selection and three cue locations. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [27. Check ASS subtitles in iCouldPlay: text, fonts and positioning](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-ass-style-fidelity-check/index.md): Compare an authorised ASS sample with simple captions to separate missing fonts, layout differences and timing problems. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [28. Organise bilingual captions for iCouldPlay in one paired file](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-bilingual-caption-layout/index.md): Pair original text and translation within individual cues, checking order, timing and small-screen density. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [29. iCouldPlay multitrack viewing: pair dialogue, commentary and captions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-audio-commentary-language-map/index.md): Identify dialogue and commentary with a fixed passage and independently verify caption counterparts in your own multitrack file. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [30. Two caption layers in iCouldPlay: distinguish recorded text from selectable subtitles](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-burned-selectable-caption-check/index.md): Use reversible comparisons to identify baked-in text, embedded tracks and external captions, and establish which layer controls affect. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [31. Choose course playback speed in iCouldPlay with speech and action checks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-course-speed-comparison/index.md): Compare available speeds on the same course segment and verify speech, demonstrations, captions and resuming. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [32. Practise iCouldPlay gestures: distinguish brightness, volume and seeking](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-gesture-brightness-volume-check/index.md): Test gesture areas and directions on a personal clip, compare visible feedback and restore the original viewing state. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [33. iCouldPlay M3U8 checks: distinguish playlists from complete offline video](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-hls-playlist-offline-boundary/index.md): Identify playlist dependencies and access conditions without treating a saved manifest as a complete offline recording. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [34. Observe HDR colour in iCouldPlay: compare source and display paths](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-hdr-colour-comparison/index.md): Compare a fixed HDR sample under consistent conditions, separating transformed copies from display behaviour. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [35. Organise personal recordings in iCouldPlay with dates and events](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-home-video-date-inventory/index.md): Create a date-and-event inventory for personal recordings and verify their real content after scanning. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [36. Plan iCouldPlay scan roots without overlapping folder scopes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-scan-root-overlap-check/index.md): Map a small source tree and verify overlapping roots, omissions and version copies against actual files. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [37. iCouldPlay server account scope: distinguish restricted access from an empty library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-server-account-content-scope/index.md): Compare catalogue, details and playback with the same account and verify intended personal library access. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [38. iCouldPlay expired-link checks: distinguish startup failure from interruption](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-expired-link-versus-buffering/index.md): Record remote failures by stage and compare refreshed authorised access with an identical local copy. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [39. Verify iCouldPlay server playback versions: originals and processed copies](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-server-original-transcoded-copy/index.md): Compare server evidence and a known original across duration, encoding, tracks and picture events. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [40. Rehearse iCouldPlay cleanup with disposable copies](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-cleanup-disposable-media-sample/index.md): Verify cleanup scope and storage effects with a disposable personal sample while retaining originals and useful viewing references. - [43. Check display edges in iCouldPlay with a numbered test border](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay-display-edge-test-card/index.md): Use a self-made border and circle to compare visible edges, caption room and scaling on the intended viewing target. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
